topic: group diffusion (structured discrete diffusion on group state spaces)

provenance.web: Exa search over springer.com, iclr.cc, mlanthology.org; article page fetched for the finite-group Fourier paper
provenance.note: IDs, venues, dates and citation counts are as returned by those endpoints on the retrieval date.

records.label: A3
records.role: discrete diffusion on the finite symmetric group S_n
records.title: SymmetricDiffusers: Learning Discrete Diffusion on Finite Symmetric Groups
records.notes: Riffle shuffle as forward transition; diffusion length guided by random-walk-on-finite-groups mixing theory; generalized Plackett-Luce reverse. Tasks: sorting 4-digit MNIST, jigsaw, TSP. Code: https://github.com/DSL-Lab/SymmetricDiffusers

records.label: A4
records.role: permutation diffusion follow-up (continuous lift of ranks)
records.title: Learning Permutation Distributions via Reflected Diffusion on Ranks
records.notes: Soft-Rank Diffusion: replaces shuffle-based corruption with a soft-rank forward process; contextualized generalized Plackett-Luce reverse. Explicitly frames shuffle-based random walks on S_n as the prior art.

records.label: A5
records.role: exact analysis of arbitrary discrete-state Markov forward processes
records.title: Blackout Diffusion: Generative Diffusion Models in Discrete-State Spaces
records.notes: Title on arXiv includes the 'Blackout Diffusion' prefix; PMLR lists it as 'Generative Diffusion Models in Discrete-State Spaces'. Derives exact (non-variational) reverse-time analysis for arbitrary discrete-state Markov forward processes.

records.label: A6
records.role: convergence theory for discrete diffusion on the hypercube
records.title: Convergence Analysis of Discrete Diffusion Model: Exact Implementation through Uniformization
records.notes: CTMC formulation; uniformization algorithm; TV and KL guarantees for sampling any distribution on a hypercube (Z/2)^d.

records.label: A7
records.role: core mathematics: convolution semigroups and Fourier diagonalization on finite groups
records.title: Harmonic flows and Markov dynamics on finite groups via pseudo-differential operators
records.venue: Journal of Pseudo-Differential Operators and Applications, 17(1), Article 18
records.notes: Builds discrete diffusion on the finite abelian group Z_N via discrete Fourier analysis, convolution semigroups, negative definite functions and pseudo-differential operators; generators shown Feller, m-dissipative and self-adjoint. Explicitly notes extension to non-abelian finite groups as open because spectral diagonalization becomes harder.

records.label: A8
records.title: Markov processes on a circular lattice
records.notes: Diffusion-generated families on the m-point cycle graph (cyclic group): explicit transition kernel, exact trigonometric moments, convergence to uniformity, discrete von Mises / wrapped Cauchy stationary laws.

records.label: A9
records.title: SE(3) diffusion model with application to protein backbone generation
records.notes: Invariant diffusion over multiple frames on SE(3); SE(3)-equivariant score over rigid-body frames.

records.label: A10
records.role: continuous group instance (SO(3), unified SGM and DDPM)
records.title: Unified framework for diffusion generative models in SO(3): applications in computer vision and astrophysics
records.notes: Extends both score-based and DDPM formulations to the Lie group SO(3); uses the tractable heat kernel on SO(3).

records.label: A11
records.role: continuous group instance (SO(3) DDPM, rotational alignment)
records.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models on SO(3) for Rotational Alignment
records.venue: ICLR 2022 Workshop on Geometrical and Topological Representation Learning
records.notes: DDPM on the rotation group; arXiv ID not confirmed this session.

records.label: A12
records.role: Riemannian/general-manifold diffusion (SO(3) is a special case)
records.title: Riemannian Score-Based Generative Modelling
records.notes: Extends score-based generative models from Euclidean space to Riemannian manifolds.

records.label: A13
records.title: Diffusion Generative Modeling on Lie Group Representations
records.notes: Score-based processes in the representation space of any (non-Abelian) Lie group; states that standard score matching is recovered as the special case of the translation group. Applications: SO(3) conformers, SE(3) docking.

records.label: A14
records.role: permutation symmetry via quotient manifold (contrast: not a group-valued state space)
records.title: Permutation-Symmetrized Diffusion for Unconditional Molecular Generation
records.notes: Diffusion on the quotient manifold R^{d x N}/S_N; heat kernel as a sum of Euclidean heat kernels over permutations.

records.label: A15
records.role: equivariance (contrast: group acts on a Euclidean state space)
records.title: SymDiff: Equivariant Diffusion via Stochastic Symmetrisation

records.label: A16
records.role: structure-preserving diffusion (contrast: group symmetries of the data distribution)
records.title: Structure Preserving Diffusion Models
